##### Project general facts

Azizi Emerald by Azizi Developments is a contemporary commercial building where business ambition meets refined design. A distinctive rounded architectural style with flowing golden balconies frames large glass facades, while an elegant upper volume rests on a solid, clean-lined base. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and five podium levels to eleven office floors and a roof, offering innovative office spaces together with retail units at street level.

Office floors present a wide variety of layouts and configurations, allowing companies to choose a footprint that suits them and to adapt the space to their own way of working. Cafes and restaurants, retail outlets, landscaped open areas, event lawns, a prayer room and social zones serve tenants and visitors, while a welcoming lobby, lifts, central air conditioning, an eco-friendly cooling system and round-the-clock security with video surveillance support a seamless working day.

Eight dedicated parking levels across the basements and podiums provide covered parking with preferred bays close to the lifts, electric vehicle charging bays, short-stay spaces for visitors and accessible parking. Elegant facades and modern interiors create a bright, prestigious working environment that reflects the status of the companies based here. Units are delivered with quality finishes, leaving the final fit-out and furniture to the requirements of each business.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Healthcare City is a thoughtfully planned district along Dubai Creek, known for its calm, green atmosphere and its reputation as the leading destination for healthcare and wellness in the region. World-class hospitals, specialised clinics, medical universities and wellness centres sit alongside boutique hotels, restaurants, cafes, banks and supermarkets, creating a professional yet relaxed setting at the centre of the city.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Oud Metha Road connect the district with the wider city, and the Dubai Healthcare City metro station is close by. Wafi Mall, Creek Park and Dubai Frame are a short drive away, the Dubai World Trade Centre and Emirates Towers are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Dubai Healthcare City offers freehold ownership to international buyers and is one of the most central business addresses in Dubai. A concentration of medical, educational and professional organisations supports steady demand for quality office and retail space. Metro access, proximity to the main business districts and the airport and a limited supply of modern commercial buildings underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
